about: What scripts/harvest_sources.py searches for. Each entry is one OpenAlex title+abstract query (boolean AND/OR, quoted phrases) tagged with the `domain` its sources carry into the index. `cap` bounds how many candidates one domain can propose, so no neighbour topic floods the aquaponics core. Scope decided 2026-09-30: aquaponics plus its neighbours, open licences only. A `topic` pins the scope to an OpenAlex topic, which is what keeps e.g. hydroponics to production papers rather than lab studies that merely USE hydroponics as a growth method (measured: without it, 'hydroponic nutrient solution' returned cadmium-uptake and Arabidopsis papers).

scopes.query: aquaponic AND (smallholder OR "small-scale" OR backyard OR household)
hydroponic AND ("nutrient solution" OR "electrical conductivity" OR NFT OR "deep water culture")
(soilless OR hydroponic) AND ("nutrient deficiency" OR iron OR potassium OR calcium) AND (lettuce OR tomato OR leafy)
"recirculating aquaculture" AND (biofilter OR nitrification OR "water quality" OR "solids removal")
(tilapia OR "Oreochromis niloticus" OR "Clarias gariepinus" OR "African catfish") AND (culture OR farming OR "stocking density" OR feeding)
(tilapia OR catfish OR carp) AND (disease OR parasite OR "Ichthyophthirius" OR Streptococcus OR biosecurity)
(greenhouse OR "screen house" OR "shade net") AND (cooling OR shading OR heat) AND (tropical OR arid OR hot)
("solar pump" OR "solar-powered pump" OR "solar irrigation") AND (smallholder OR farm OR aquaculture)
(aquaponic OR aquaculture OR hydroponic) AND ("economic feasibility" OR profitability OR "cost-benefit" OR "business model")
(aquaponic OR hydroponic OR aquaculture) AND ("food safety" OR "Escherichia coli" OR Salmonella OR pathogen)
("Burkina Faso" OR Sahel OR "West Africa" OR Niger OR Mali) AND (aquaculture OR "fish farming" OR "vegetable production" OR "market gardening" OR irrigation)
(Taiwan OR "subtropical Asia") AND (aquaculture OR aquaponic OR "leafy vegetable" OR greenhouse)
